exposure: Maternal hs-CRP levels during pregnancy and postpartum
outcome: hs-CRP levels in children at 6 months of age
cohort: 690 mother-child pairs from the Copenhagen Prospective Studies on Asthma in Childhood(2010) (COPSAC(2010)) cohort
finding: Maternal hs-CRP levels during pregnancy were positively associated with hs-CRP levels in their children at 6 months of age, independent of various maternal and infant factors, suggesting a correlation between systemic low-grade inflammation in mothers and their offspring.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with higher maternal hs-CRP levels.
